Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Kunal: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal hugs Mother tightly.]

Anjali: "Careful!"

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Anjali (laughing): "Show me too!"

[Kunal gives Mother a flower.]

Anjali: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Kunal stands in the park. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal throws the ball to Mother.]

Anjali (gently): "Kunal, are you okay?"

[Kunal catches the ball.]

Anjali: "Kunal, are you okay?"

[Kunal kicks the football hard.]

Kunal: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Kunal swings on the swing.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

[Kunal goes down the slide.]

Kunal: "How beautiful!"

[Kunal does yoga on a mat.]

Anjali: "Really?"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Kunal is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Kunal wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Kunal (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
